column1: to provide for the setting  out of rights and entitlements of victims of crime
and  witnesses  and  the  protection  and  promotion  of  such  rights  and
entitlements; to give effect to appropriate international norms, standards
and best practices relating to the assistance to and protection of victims of
crime  and  witnesses;  to  provide  for  the  establishment  of  the  National
Authority for the Protection of Victims of Crime and Witnesses, the Victims
of Crime and  Witnesses Assistance and Protection Division and the Victims
of Crime and Witnesses Assistance and Protection Fund; to provide for the
payment of compensation to victims of crime; to repeal the Assistance to
and  Protection  of  Victims  of  Crime  and  Witnesses  Act,  No.  4  of  2015;
and  to  provide  for  matters  connected  therewith  or  incidental  thereto
